open_points.subject: publish_progress_photo
open_points.text: - publish_progress_photo: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST open exactly one transaction, read the replay candidate only through tx.progress_photos().get_progress_photo_by_intake_id with publication.intake_id, resolve a supplied section only through tx.project_sections().get_project_section with context.project_id inside that same transaction, insert only through tx.progress_photos().insert_progress_photo, append the audit only through tx.audit(), and commit exactly once; it MUST NOT call validate_project_section, open a second transaction while its own is active, or use a legacy transaction-level photo or project-section method.
open_points.other_text: - publish_progress_photo: [RETURN_SHAPE] When a photo already exists for publication.intake_id, MUST close that read transaction by exactly one rollback, marking it closed before the replay content comparison, then return the existing record with replayed true; a cross-project match or any content disagreement MUST raise PhotoConflictError. Neither replay path may insert a row, update a row, or append an audit.
open_points.question: Must the replay transaction commit exactly once or roll back exactly once?

open_points.subject: publish_progress_photo
open_points.text: - publish_progress_photo: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST open exactly one transaction, read the replay candidate only through tx.progress_photos().get_progress_photo_by_intake_id with publication.intake_id, resolve a supplied section only through tx.project_sections().get_project_section with context.project_id inside that same transaction, insert only through tx.progress_photos().insert_progress_photo, append the audit only through tx.audit(), and commit exactly once; it MUST NOT call validate_project_section, open a second transaction while its own is active, or use a legacy transaction-level photo or project-section method.
open_points.other_text: - publish_progress_photo: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST raise PhotoValidationError when publication.project_id differs from context.project_id before opening any transaction, and when the supplied section is missing or belongs to another project after the scoped read. The transaction guard MUST close its transaction exactly once, roll back on failure only while the transaction is still open, and re-raise the original failure unchanged; substituting a translated persistence error for PhotoValidationError or PhotoConflictError is forbidden.
open_points.question: Does the exactly-one-transaction and exactly-one-commit requirement exclude project-id validation failures and other failure paths, or must the validation rule change?

open_points.subject: update_progress_photo
open_points.text: - update_progress_photo: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST open exactly one transaction, read the photo only through tx.progress_photos().get_progress_photo with photo_id, resolve a supplied section only through tx.project_sections().get_project_section with context.project_id inside that same transaction, write only through tx.progress_photos().update_progress_photo, append the audit only through tx.audit(), and commit exactly once; it MUST NOT call validate_project_section, open a second transaction while its own is active, or use a legacy transaction-level photo or project-section method.
open_points.other_text: - update_progress_photo: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST raise PhotoValidationError when no photo matches photo_id, when the matched photo belongs to another project, and when the supplied section is missing or belongs to another project; the write MUST NOT commit in any of those cases. The transaction guard MUST close its transaction exactly once, roll back on failure only while the transaction is still open, and re-raise the original failure unchanged; substituting a translated persistence error for PhotoValidationError is forbidden.
open_points.question: Is commit exactly once required only on the successful update path, or must validation failures also commit despite the explicit prohibition?
